methods.label: Common interval
methods.explanation: Take the intersection of the solution sets of the 2 inequalities: greater than 1 and no greater than 4, giving \(1<x\leq4\).
methods.levelReason: Finding the common values of two given bounds is a direct Grade 7 inequality-system procedure.
